method: Hand-curated list of PUBLIC Catholic organizations only (parish young adult groups, campus ministries, diocesan young adult offices, traditional-liturgy parishes and public event series), found with web search on 2026-10-29. No private people are listed and no individual's name is recorded. Every URL, age wording, schedule and description comes from a search result; nothing was filled in from memory. The official hosts did not resolve from the research container, so no page was fetched: every row is verification 'listed_from_search' with verified_at null, and notes say what the search result showed. age_scope_published is null throughout because no page was read directly; any age wording seen in search is in notes. geo_id is a 5-digit county FIPS only where the venue is a single site in a county we are certain of; diocese-wide offices and ambiguous towns are null with city/state (and county_name when known) for the pipeline to join. An organization's existence does not prove a sizable dating pool; schedules change, so check the page before going.

categories.parish_young_adult: A parish's young adult group or event series
categories.campus_ministry: Catholic campus ministry or Newman center; usually aimed at students of that university
categories.diocesan_young_adult_office: A diocese's young adult office or network (diocese-wide, not one site)
categories.traditional_liturgy: A parish or community offering the Traditional Latin Mass
